items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: You said they had Raymond Brown and George McCullum. And myself. And? And now, Harry Fagli too, he's playing banjo.

ctx.x: Well, they think there are reasons they are.
Oh, I never did get much more about Clara Statham. You said they had Raymond Brown and George McCullum. And myself. And?
And now, Harry Fagli too, he's playing banjo.
